contexts.text: That in leprosy the colours of the hair and beard were to be observed; as white, reddish, yellow, black; and also in the garments; and that he who was cleansed from leprosy was to shave off all the hair of his head, beard, and eyebrows () signified falsities unclean from what is profane, which is leprosy in the internal sense.
As leprosy = the profanation of truth...
His hands as leprous as snow () = the profanation of truth. Hands = ... truth; and leprous = profanation; in special, the profanation of truth.
The reason leprosy is so much treated of, is... that it signified the profanation of truth... and because the Jews and Israelites could profane truth more than others...

That leprosy = the profanation of truth, is evident from the statutes concerning leprosy in . In this description there is contained in the internal sense every quality of the profanation of truth, Enumerated. But as the things described by leprosy are profane, it is not allowable to explain them particularly...

One who is leprous from the head to the heel () means one who knows internal truths, but does not acknowledge them... He is not interiorly in profanation, but exteriorly, which is removed; and therefore he is clean. But if he knows the truths of faith, and believes them, and yet lives contrary to them... he is in profanation interiorly; and so is he who has believed, and afterwards denies; and therefore it is said that in the day in which living flesh has appeared in him he shall be unclean...
The sores of the leprosy... mentioned in , are also such (falsities); for leprosy = the profanation of truth.
He who is leprous () = the profanation of the truth of faith.
The lepers are cleansed ()... The lepers = those who are unclean, and who still long to be cleansed.
For leprosy = truth profaned, thus falsified.

As the Jewish nation was in the profanation of the Word, and this is signified by leprosy, they had leprosy not only in their flesh, but also in their garments, houses, and vessels; and the kinds of profanation are signified by the various evils of the leprosy, Enumerated, AE 962:10.
The face (of the devil) was leprous from his forehead to his chin; and also both his hands.
She infects them with her leprosy.
Leprosy treated of, and Explained. WE 5555. WE 5559. WE 5560. WE 5565. WE 5600. WE 5605. WE 5616. WE 5621. WE 5640.
By Naaman the leper was represented those who falsify... For leprosy = falsifications. (The curing of his leprosy Fully Explained.)
As by leprosy is signified good consumed through falsities, the method of the restoration of this evil by Divine means is described by the process of the cleansing of the leprosy... in ...
As by leprosy is signified the profanation of truth, and the profanation of truth is various its effects are various, which are signified by the appearances in the leprosy, Enumerated.
